content: {"like":["Values strong father‑friend dynamics and emotionally weighty scenes","Appreciates high‑quality English dubbing and standout voice actors like Steve Blum","Enjoys well‑developed character arcs, especially in episodes featuring deep questions or backstory revelations","Prefers episodes that balance action with meaningful dialogue and character growth","Finds certain character introductions (e.g., teenage gatekeeper Kaoru) engaging when they add depth to the story"],"dislike":["Dislikes dry, action‑poor storytelling and bland heroes","Criticizes poorly animated or jarring visual quality, especially in fanservice or period settings","Finds repetitive or clichéd antagonists and plot devices frustrating","Rejects harem dynamics that expand without narrative justification","Avoids episodes with filler content, weak character development, or inappropriate romantic elements"]}
